player_prompt.intro:
Uwite Umukino {player_id} mu mukino wa {num_rounds}-round of IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Mu gihe cyo kila mugoroba, tekereza umubare kati ya {min_guess} na {max_guess}.
Nyuma y’ibitegetso byombi, inyandiko ni (2/3)x(urwego rw’ibitegetso byombi),
na umukino utose inyandiko ili kuza kuri inyandiko ya mbere inyandiko ya round.
Wandanike ibitegetso byawe mu kibanza '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ibirimo ntibikwiye; nyamuneka bandika igishushanyo cyawe nka [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Gufata umwanzuro ugomba kuba uri hagati ya {min_guess} na {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Player 0 guessed {guess0}; Player 1 guessed {guess1}. Thus the Target is: {target}.

outcome.p1_wins: Umukinnyi wa mbere yatsinze imikino myinshi.
outcome.draw: Muri rusange, umukino warangiye ari ubusa ku busa.
